messages.subject: [ANN] SciCom 0.3.0
parts:
Hello....

I´ve just released version 0.3.0 of SciCom.  This version adds method R.install__package to SciCom, allowing dynamic loading of libraries the same way as in R. 

If interested:

  • install jruby
  • on the command shell: jruby -S gem install scicom

Cheers,


Rodrigo
